messages:
maria: Heads-up — opened a docs PR for a model-catalog migration playbook. It bundles sample queries, SDK snippets, and a short list of compatibility pitfalls. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482
ben: :eyes: reading now. we should include an explicit long-context example for aurora-lite3b (seq 8k) — folks keep hitting truncation surprises.
maria: agreed. added a small table and a short curl example for long-context. snippet:
```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"model":"aurora-lite3b","input":"<very long chat...>","max_tokens":512}'
```
ben: can you call out batching effects? some customers saw latency bumps when batch windows are small for long sequences.
carlos: noted. also need an SDK note: pass model_variant for quantized fallback. e.g. python:
```py
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
res = client.generate(model='aurora-lite3b', model_variant='q4_0', input='hi')
```
and JS equivalent. will add both.
dana: there's a broken anchor on the runtime fallback page — `/docs/runtime#fallbacks` changed to `#fallback-policies`. pls update links in the playbook.
maria: nice catch, fixed links and added a short section: "When to prefer a variant vs a separate model" with a tiny decision flow.
ben: compatibility pitfalls checklist looks good but add a line about embedding sharding for large corpora (shard alignment and cosine resets).
carlos: adding a short code comment about embedding_shard_count and an example of client-side stitching.
dana: can we also mention quota/cost implications of autoscaling for Dedicated? customers misread throughput limits as free. tiny blurb under "limits."
maria: added a cost/throughput callout and linked to pricing FAQ.
doc-bot: Preview build complete: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.ai/482 :white_check_mark: (build 7312)
ben: I'll do a quick pass on the pitfalls table and sample queries in ~45m. no blockers from infra.
maria: thanks all — if reviews are clean I'll merge after 3pm PT. ping me for follow-ups or if you want a different snippet style. :thumbsup:
